# updatePersonNote — PUT /people/{vanId}/notes/{noteId}

Update a note on a person

## Verified behaviors

- **Updating a note is refused for this key, before the note is looked up** — Every request from the research key is refused with 403 FORBIDDEN whether or not the note exists, so the success path documented for this operation comes from the official docs alone. ([replay](../behaviors/note-update-restricted-for-this-key.md))

## Behavior

Updates an existing note. Only `text`, `isViewRestricted` and `category` can be changed; `isPinned` and the note's contact history cannot.

**This action is restricted for the key used to research this spec.** Every request returns 403 FORBIDDEN "Access to this action is restricted", whether or not the note exists, so the success path has not been observed live — the request body and the 204 below come from the official docs. `GET` and `DELETE` on this same path are restricted the same way; they are left out of this spec because their success shapes are unknown and undocumented.

## Differs from the official docs

- **parameters / noteId** — Official docs type this path parameter as string (default "225"); the route only matches integers (observed 2026-08-04).

## Example

```bash
curl -sS -X PUT \
  'https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/102714507/notes/184579' \
  -u "app-name:$NGP_API_KEY|1" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "text": "Updated after a follow-up call."
}'
```

## Path parameters

| Name | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vanId` * | integer (int32) | VAN id of the person the note belongs to. |
| `noteId` * | integer (int32) | Id of the note to edit, as returned by GET /people/{vanId}/notes. |

`*` = required.

## Request body (required)

Changes to apply to an existing note. Only these three fields can be updated.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The new body of the note. The length limits are those of the create endpoint; they have not been checked on update. |
| `isViewRestricted` | boolean | Restricts the note to certain users in the context. Setting this to true makes the note invisible to API keys from then on. |
| `category` | object | The category to file a note under. |
| `category.noteCategoryId` * | integer (int32) | Id of a category from GET /notes/categories whose `assignableTypes` contain `Person`. An id outside that set returns 400 INVALID_PARAMETER. `noteCategoryId: 0` — the value the API itself reports for an uncategorized note — returns 500, so omit `category` entirely instead of sending zero. e.g. `24` |

`*` = required.
